components.purpose: Page-top heading/intro section introducing the pricing page (e.g. 'Pricing' headline and supporting description) before the plans are shown.

The core of the request — renders the three plans side by side as cards, with each card's nested Pricing Tier item providing the plan name, description, price (PriceMonthly/Currency/CurrencySymbol), highlights, and a sign-up CTA button (ctaButton link field).
